courses.title: Fear Buster Session
courses.description: A fifty-minute one-to-one Zoom session on a single fear or limiting belief, combining EFT tapping, hypnosis and eye-movement work with spiritual and energy practices to replace it with a more supportive belief.

courses.title: Psychic Clearing Session
courses.description: A fifty-minute one-to-one session in which George reads the aura and chakras for cords, attachments and other heavy energies, clears them, and teaches simple psychic-protection habits to keep your energy clear.
